description: Captures the context of a survey — purpose, subject, recruiting, who is missing, audience and expectations — in a short interview and stores it as a Markdown document next to the CSV (<name>.context.md). Every other survey skill reads it when present, so reports state the study design instead of guessing it. Use before the first analysis of a new data set, to update an existing context document, or to turn an existing briefing into one. Invoke with your CSV path or briefing text as the argument, e.g. /survey-context [CSV path].
